layers.label: Semantic Jira requirement graph
layers.falsifier: A Markdown, chat or generated projection becomes work authority or changes the exact Chicago subject.

layers.label: GraphLaw semantic admission and refusal
layers.falsifier: A GraphLaw or ash_graphlaw result actuates directly, or semantic state is duplicated with different meaning in XaaS.

layers.label: SA2A capability and delegation transport
layers.pathScope: capability discovery, identity, delegation, consequence contract, CommandBus boundary
layers.falsifier: Routing, delivery, message metadata or capability possession grants DO or changes subject identity.

layers.label: ash_pplan and ferroplan planning
layers.pathScope: ash_pplan planning semantics -> ferroplan HDDL/FOND search -> realization candidates
layers.falsifier: Planner equals policy/executor/authority, stale plans survive semantic drift, or recovery silently widens authority.

layers.label: XaaS runtime existence and execution state
layers.pathScope: Ash domains, runs, epochs, leases, execution fabric, actuation, receipts
layers.falsifier: XaaS fabric bypasses the admitted consequence boundary, retries UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH blindly, or reports execution not observed.

layers.label: ex4pm / ash_ex4pm OCEL evidence
layers.pathScope: Ash action -> ex4pm ingestion -> OCEL 2.0 event/evidence projection
layers.falsifier: A projected or inferred event is presented as observed execution, or OCEL identity cannot reconcile to the runtime subject.

layers.label: beam4pm process conformance and replay
layers.pathScope: process model, conformance, replay, deviation and recovery analysis
layers.falsifier: Conformance inference is promoted to observed fact or standing, or replay changes the semantic outcome without a typed divergence.

layers.label: Affidavit evidence and standing
layers.pathScope: affidavit WASM engine + Ash membrane + receipt/provenance/standing projection
layers.falsifier: Evidence can be replayed across subjects, forged from runtime computation, or treated as execution authority.

layers.label: AshSurface human projection
layers.pathScope: AshSurface IR, CommandCenter, observations, obligations, planning episodes, evidence and standing
layers.falsifier: AshSurface invents business semantics, grants DO, fabricates ALIVE, or seller/buyer/operator projections disagree on subject identity.

layers.label: ggen-marketplace deterministic Chicago renderer
layers.pathScope: marketplace pack: canonical query/templates -> generated Chicago machine/verification/executive/replay views
layers.falsifier: Generated Chicago artifacts are hand edited, generator output changes without source/tool identity change, or a generated view acquires authority.

falsifiers.label: Cross-layer subject drift
falsifiers.description: Any required layer reports a different semantic subject without an explicit receipted projection relation.

falsifiers.label: Projection or analysis gains authority
falsifiers.description: A requirement, transport, plan, semantic admission, process finding, evidence result, generated artifact or AshSurface view grants or implies protected DO.

falsifiers.label: Standing inherited by adjacency
falsifiers.description: A layer is shown ALIVE solely because an upstream or neighboring layer is ALIVE, without its own exact-subject court and receipt.

scenarios.label: Bounded authorized purchase
scenarios.description: A bounded purchase with valid identity and delegation is the positive path; execution/ALIVE must still be established by the owning runtime/evidence courts.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Amount exceeds delegated limit
scenarios.description: The requested amount exceeds the admitted delegated limit and must produce a typed refusal with no protected DO.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Wrong principal
scenarios.description: The principal does not match the delegated authority subject and must be refused before protected DO.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Expired delegation
scenarios.description: An expired delegation is stale authority and must be refused rather than refreshed implicitly.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Provider unavailable before dispatch
scenarios.description: Pre-dispatch provider unavailability preserves other admitted realizations and may trigger bounded replanning without changing authority.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Unknown after dispatch
scenarios.description: A timeout or disconnect after dispatch is UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH; reconcile the original consequence and never blind replay.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Missing evidence cannot promote standing
scenarios.description: A consequence may be claimed or inferred, but absent the required exact-subject evidence and receipt the layer cannot promote to ALIVE.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Stale or mismatched subject
scenarios.description: A receipt, plan or evidence object bound to a different subject or stale semantic identity is refused rather than generalized.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Semantic policy drift invalidates stale plan
scenarios.description: When relevant semantic/policy premises change, a stale plan loses applicability and the planner must re-enter bounded selection/replanning.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

scenarios.label: Human projection cannot mint authority
scenarios.description: Operator, buyer, seller and engineer views may differ in presentation but none may grant DO or change the exact semantic subject/evidence.
scenarios.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001
